description: Premium commercial stock rendering with balanced tonal depth, accurate color, natural detail, and broad licensing suitability without appearing flat or unfinished.
editing_goals: Produce a professionally finished commercial image suitable for a wide variety of stock-photo subjects.
Create balanced tonal separation with clean highlights, controlled shadows, confident white points, and natural black depth.
Enhance overall clarity, color, and detail while remaining visually neutral.
Deliver immediate thumbnail impact without obvious stylistic processing.
Preserve maximum commercial flexibility across editorial, travel, business, lifestyle, architecture, food, objects, and nature.
cautions: Avoid weak, gray, flat, or unfinished rendering.
Avoid oversaturated colors or excessive local contrast.
Avoid halos, clipping, or artificial sharpening.
Maintain believable skin, foliage, skies, and neutral materials.
Prioritize broad commercial usability over artistic interpretation.

guidance: Use reliable architectural or natural horizontal references.
Do not alter intentionally dynamic compositions.
Prioritize commercial usability over mathematical perfection.
